context: Whole-message editorial pass for remaining formal selection/admin import prompts in seven language families. Choose/upload covers and category actions, bulk user selection, access roles and account verification email/handle lists. Handles are identifiers, not descriptions; actual admin actions are only labels, no messages sent. Brand/user content untouched.

Select all visible users.hu: Jelöld ki az összes látható felhasználót

Select a new access role for this user..ru: Выбери новую роль доступа для этого пользователя.
Select a new access role for this user..uk: Вибери нову роль доступу для цього користувача.
